vab.source: IBGE, Contas Regionais do Brasil 2021, SIDRA Table 5938 (sum of 27 UFs)

agriculture.name: Agropecuária
agriculture.source: IBGE, PNAD Contínua Trimestral 2024 (T4), Grupamento de atividade
agriculture.notes: Agriculture has highest informality due to family farming, seasonal work, and self-employment without CNPJ. Hours: formal workers cluster at 44h; many informal work <40h.

industry.name: Indústria (incl. construção)
industry.source: IBGE, PNAD Contínua Trimestral 2024 (T4), Grupamento de atividade
industry.notes: Industry (extractive + manufacturing + utilities + construction) has low informality in manufacturing (CLT-dominated) but higher in construction (~45%). Blended rate ~22.8%.

services.name: Serviços
services.source: IBGE, PNAD Contínua Trimestral 2024 (T4), Grupamento de atividade
services.notes: Services encompass commerce, transport, accommodation, IT, finance, public admin, education, health, domestic work. Informality driven by self-employed (conta-própria) and domestic workers without carteira.

agriculture.source: Estimated from DIEESE 2024 + RAIS sector composition

industry.source: Estimated from DIEESE 2024 + RAIS sector composition
industry.notes: Industry: mix of 40h (continuous shifts) and 44h (standard CLT)

services.source: Estimated from DIEESE 2024 + RAIS sector composition
services.notes: Services: highest part-time share due to commerce/domestic/education
